## Today's learning {#ss1-objective}

### Lesson objective

We are learning to describe sequences using notation and rules.

### Success criteria

I can use a sequence's rule and allowed indices to find and identify its terms.

::: notes
Keep this short and move directly into OEIS. The three syllabus points beside Section 1 cover ordered lists, positive-integer indices and finite/infinite sequences. Explicit and recursive rules support the booklet examples. Do not introduce arithmetic/geometric formulas or series yet.
:::
